tense_01.timelineDesc: 把动作看成规律、事实或稳定状态，不把镜头放进某一次过程。

sentences.negative: I do not prepare them on Sundays.
sentences.question: Do you prepare them yourself?

scenarios.title: 习惯与规律
scenarios.explain: 反复发生；问的是「通常怎样」。
scenarios.example: I check emails every morning. 我每天早晨查邮件。

scenarios.title: 事实与长期状态
scenarios.explain: 客观事实、身份、拥有、看法。
scenarios.example: Water boils at 100°C. 水在100°C沸腾。

scenarios.title: 固定时刻表
scenarios.explain: 公共日程、课程、航班等已固定。
scenarios.example: The train leaves at eight tomorrow. 火车明早8点发车。

scenarios.title: 时间/条件从句表未来
scenarios.explain: when / if / until 后不用 will。
scenarios.example: I'll call you when I arrive. 我到了就给你电话。

tense_01.collocations: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays；状态动词：know, believe, own, belong, need。
tense_01.confusion: today 只是时间范围：说习惯用一般现在；说此刻过程用现在进行；说今天已有成果用现在完成。

tense_02.timelineDesc: 动作正在现在附近展开；它是临时过程，不是稳定规律。

sentences.affirmative: I am preparing a quotation now.
sentences.negative: I am not working at the office today.
sentences.question: Are you meeting the buyer tomorrow?

scenarios.title: 此刻正在发生
scenarios.explain: 说话时动作正在进行。
scenarios.example: She is talking to a customer now. 她正在和客户谈。

scenarios.title: 当前阶段的临时状态
scenarios.explain: 不一定此秒发生，但目前持续。
scenarios.example: I'm working from home this week. 我本周居家办公。

scenarios.title: 变化与趋势
scenarios.explain: 状态正在逐渐变化。
scenarios.example: Prices are rising. 价格正在上涨。

scenarios.title: 已落实的未来安排
scenarios.explain: 时间、对象等通常已确认。
scenarios.example: I'm meeting the supplier at ten. 我十点要见供应商。

tense_02.collocations: now, right now, at the moment, currently, this week；Look! / Listen!；always + doing 可表达反复且带情绪。
tense_02.confusion: I work from home = 长期/习惯；I am working from home this week = 本周临时状态。

tense_03.timelineDesc: 动作在过去发生，但结果、经历或未结束的时间范围仍连接现在。

sentences.negative: I have not received a reply yet.
sentences.question: Have you checked it?

scenarios.title: 已完成，结果在现在
scenarios.explain: 动作结束；现在能看到结果。
scenarios.example: I have finished the report. 报告已完成，现在可看。

scenarios.title: 人生经历
scenarios.explain: 不说具体过去时间，关注是否经历过。
scenarios.example: Have you ever visited London? 你去过伦敦吗？

scenarios.title: 未结束时间范围
scenarios.explain: today / this week 仍未结束。
scenarios.example: I have sent three emails today. 今天已发三封。

scenarios.title: 从过去延续至今的状态
scenarios.explain: 状态动词常配 since / for。
scenarios.example: I have known her for years. 我认识她很多年了。

tense_03.collocations: already, yet, just, ever, never, so far, up to now, recently, since, for, this week。
tense_03.confusion: yesterday / last week 是已结束的过去时间，用一般过去；so far / today 常连接现在。

tense_04.timelineDesc: 从过去持续到现在，镜头追踪过程、时长或刚停下留下的痕迹。

sentences.affirmative: I have been preparing quotations since nine.
sentences.negative: I have not been sleeping well lately.
sentences.question: How long have you been waiting?
sentences.passive: 通常改写主动，避免笨重被动。

scenarios.title: 持续到现在
scenarios.explain: 动作仍在继续，突出持续过程。
scenarios.example: I have been studying since nine. 我从9点一直学到现在。

scenarios.title: 刚停下但有现时证据
scenarios.explain: 动作可能刚结束，痕迹仍明显。
scenarios.example: It has been raining. 地面湿，刚才一直在下雨。

scenarios.title: 一段时间内反复发生
scenarios.explain: 不是一次完成，而是反复活动。
scenarios.example: She has been calling all morning. 她一上午一直在打电话。

scenarios.title: 解释当前状态
scenarios.explain: 当前疲惫、凌乱等由持续动作造成。
scenarios.example: I'm tired because I've been working. 我因一直工作而累。

tense_04.collocations: since, for, all day, all morning, lately, recently, how long；常与 still / yet 的未完成语境相呼应。
tense_04.confusion: have done 看成果/数量；have been doing 看过程/时长。两种信息可在同一段中并存。

tense_06.timelineDesc: 站在过去某一时刻，看到当时正在展开的背景过程。

sentences.affirmative: I was writing when she called.
sentences.negative: I was not using the computer then.
sentences.question: Were you waiting at ten?

scenarios.title: 过去某时正在进行
scenarios.explain: 把镜头停在过去时间点。
scenarios.example: At eight, I was studying. 8点时我正在学习。

scenarios.title: 背景动作被打断
scenarios.explain: 长过程用进行时；短事件用一般过去时。
scenarios.example: I was writing when he called. 他来电时我正在写。

scenarios.title: 两个动作同时进行
scenarios.explain: while 常连接平行过程。
scenarios.example: She was talking while I was taking notes. 她说话时，我在记。

scenarios.title: 委婉说明原本想法
scenarios.explain: I was hoping/wondering 降低直接感。
scenarios.example: I was hoping you could help. 我本想请您帮忙。

tense_06.collocations: at 8 yesterday, at that moment, while, when, all evening；背景描述常用。
tense_06.confusion: 长背景常用 was doing；插入的短事件常用 did：I was writing when she called。

tense_07.timelineDesc: 两个过去动作中，先发生的动作退到更早一层：过去之前的过去。

sentences.affirmative: I had sent it before she called.
sentences.negative: I had not seen the new price list.
sentences.question: Had the meeting started?

scenarios.title: 早于另一过去事件
scenarios.explain: 先发生用 had done，后发生用过去时。
scenarios.example: The meeting had started when I arrived. 我到时会已开始。

scenarios.title: 解释过去结果
scenarios.explain: 此前事件造成当时状态。
scenarios.example: She was upset because she had lost the file. 她因丢文件而难过。

scenarios.title: 过去视角中的经历
scenarios.explain: 到那个过去点为止是否经历过。
scenarios.example: I had never seen it before then. 那以前我从未见过。

scenarios.title: 虚拟/遗憾结构
scenarios.explain: if only / wish / third conditional 指未成事实。
scenarios.example: If I had known, I would have acted. 若早知，我会行动。

tense_07.collocations: by then, before, after, already, never...before, by the time + 过去时。
tense_07.confusion: 过去完成必须依附过去参照点；没有第二个过去时，不要为了「高级」机械使用 had done。

tense_08.timelineDesc: 到某个过去点之前，动作已经持续一段时间；焦点在此前的过程和时长。

sentences.affirmative: She had been talking for an hour.
sentences.negative: She had not been waiting long.
sentences.question: How long had you been working?
sentences.passive: 通常改写主动，避免笨重被动。

scenarios.title: 持续到过去某点
scenarios.explain: 突出在那个时刻之前的时长。
scenarios.example: She had been talking for an hour when I arrived. 我到时她已谈1小时。

scenarios.title: 解释过去状态
scenarios.explain: 持续活动造成当时结果。
scenarios.example: He was tired because he had been driving. 他因一直开车而累。

scenarios.title: 过去之前反复发生
scenarios.explain: 在过去参照点前多次进行。
scenarios.example: They had been meeting weekly. 此前他们每周见面。

scenarios.title: 刚在过去点前停止
scenarios.explain: 过程可能已停，但痕迹仍在。
scenarios.example: The road was wet; it had been raining. 路湿，先前一直下雨。

tense_08.collocations: for, since, all day, how long, before, when, by the time；必须有过去参照点。
tense_08.confusion: had done 看过去点前的成果；had been doing 看过去点前持续了多久。

tense_10.timelineDesc: 把镜头放到未来某时，观察届时正在进行的动作或自然行程。

sentences.affirmative: I will be meeting the supplier at ten.
sentences.negative: I will not be using the room then.
sentences.question: Will you be travelling next week?
sentences.passive: 进行被动很笨重，优先改写。

scenarios.title: 未来某时正在发生
scenarios.explain: 未来时间点切入过程内部。
scenarios.example: At ten, I'll be meeting the supplier. 10点时我会在见供应商。

scenarios.title: 正常安排中的过程
scenarios.explain: 强调届时自然会做，不突出临时决定。
scenarios.example: I'll be visiting clients next week. 下周我会拜访客户。

scenarios.title: 礼貌询问安排
scenarios.explain: 询问对方原有计划，压力更小。
scenarios.example: Will you be using the room? 您到时会用会议室吗？

scenarios.title: 预测正在发展的状态
scenarios.explain: 预计未来阶段持续。
scenarios.example: More buyers will be shopping online. 更多买家将在线采购。

tense_10.collocations: at this time tomorrow, at 10 tomorrow, this time next week, all day tomorrow。
tense_10.confusion: I am meeting her at ten 强调已经约好；I will be meeting her at ten 强调届时过程/行程。

tense_11.timelineDesc: 站在未来截止点回看：动作在那之前已完成或累计到某个数量。

sentences.affirmative: I will have finished by Friday.
sentences.negative: I will not have finished by noon.
sentences.question: Will you have completed it by then?
sentences.passive: The goods will have been shipped.

scenarios.title: 未来截止前完成
scenarios.explain: 关心到某时前是否完成。
scenarios.example: I'll have finished by Friday. 到周五我就完成了。

scenarios.title: 到未来点累计成果
scenarios.explain: 统计届时的数量/成就。
scenarios.example: By June, we'll have served 500 clients. 到6月将服务500位。

scenarios.title: 按时间推算已发生
scenarios.explain: 偶尔用来推测到现在已完成。
scenarios.example: She will have arrived by now. 按理她现在已到。

scenarios.title: 期限内的被动完成
scenarios.explain: 突出事项在截止前被处理。
scenarios.example: The goods will have been shipped by Friday. 周五前会发出。

tense_11.collocations: by, by then, by the time, before, by the end of, within...；by 是不迟于截止点。
tense_11.confusion: by five = 不迟于5点，常看完成；at five = 正在5点那个时刻，常看当时状态/过程。

tense_12.timelineDesc: 到未来某点时，动作将已经持续多久；重点是累计时长而非完成数量。

sentences.affirmative: By June, I will have been studying for six months.
sentences.negative: I will not have been working there for a year.
sentences.question: How long will you have been waiting?
sentences.passive: 极少使用，优先换主语或拆句。

scenarios.title: 累计到未来的时长
scenarios.explain: 动作通常还会继续。
scenarios.example: By June, I'll have been studying for six months. 到6月将学满半年。

scenarios.title: 解释未来状态
scenarios.explain: 持续过程将造成未来结果。
scenarios.example: I'll be tired; I'll have been working all day. 届时会因工作一天而累。

scenarios.title: 持续的工作/项目
scenarios.explain: 突出项目持续而非交付成果。
scenarios.example: Next year, we'll have been exporting for a decade. 明年出口满10年。

scenarios.title: 持续到截止点附近
scenarios.explain: 结合 by + 未来点 + for + 时长。
scenarios.example: By noon, she'll have been waiting for three hours. 中午时她将等3小时。

tense_12.collocations: by + 未来时间, for + 时长, by then, by the time；常同时出现截止点和持续时长。
tense_12.confusion: will have done 看届时成果；will have been doing 看届时已经持续的过程。

tense_13.timelineDesc: 站在过去看当时尚未发生的未来；常用于转述过去的计划、承诺或预测。

sentences.negative: She said she would not delay.
sentences.question: Would the plan work?
sentences.passive: The order would be approved later.

scenarios.title: 转述过去的未来
scenarios.explain: will 在过去报道语境常后移为 would。
scenarios.example: She said she would call. 她说她会打来。

scenarios.title: 过去的预测/预期
scenarios.explain: 从当时看，后来会发生。
scenarios.example: I knew the plan would work. 我当时知道计划会奏效。

scenarios.title: 过去的意愿或拒绝
scenarios.explain: would / wouldn't 可表当时意愿。
scenarios.example: He wouldn't agree. 他当时不肯同意。

scenarios.title: 条件结果
scenarios.explain: would + V 也用于现在/未来虚拟。
scenarios.example: I would go if I had time. 若有时间我会去。

tense_13.collocations: said, thought, knew, promised, expected + would；the next day, later, soon。
tense_13.confusion: would 还可表示虚拟、过去习惯和礼貌；看到 would 不能自动判断为过去将来。

tense_14.timelineDesc: 站在过去，想象后来某一时刻动作会正在进行。

sentences.affirmative: I thought she would be working at ten.
sentences.negative: I knew he would not be travelling.
sentences.question: Would they be waiting then?
sentences.passive: 形式过重，真实表达通常改写。

scenarios.title: 过去预计的未来过程
scenarios.explain: 当时预计后来某时正在发生。
scenarios.example: I thought she would be working at ten. 我以为她10点会在工作。

scenarios.title: 转述将来进行时
scenarios.explain: will be doing 后移为 would be doing。
scenarios.example: He said he would be travelling the next day. 他说次日会在旅行。

scenarios.title: 过去计划中的自然行程
scenarios.explain: 突出当时安排里的过程。
scenarios.example: We knew we would be meeting buyers all day. 我们知道会见一天买家。

scenarios.title: 条件下的进行过程
scenarios.explain: 在假设条件下届时会正在做。
scenarios.example: Without the delay, I would be flying now. 若没延误我现在会在飞。

tense_14.collocations: thought/said/knew + would be doing；at that later time, the next day, the following week。
tense_14.confusion: was doing = 当时正在做；would be doing = 从更早的过去看，后来会正在做。

tense_15.timelineDesc: 站在过去，预计某个后来截止点之前已经完成；也常表达未实现的过去结果。

sentences.affirmative: I thought she would have finished by Friday.
sentences.negative: I thought she would not have left.
sentences.question: Would the goods have arrived by then?
sentences.passive: The order would have been approved.

scenarios.title: 过去预计后来已完成
scenarios.explain: 当时对后续截止结果的预期。
scenarios.example: I thought she would have finished by Friday. 我以为她周五前会完成。

scenarios.title: 转述将来完成时
scenarios.explain: will have done 后移为 would have done。
scenarios.example: He said the goods would have arrived by then. 他说届时货会到。

scenarios.title: 与事实相反的过去结果
scenarios.explain: 第三条件句/遗憾中非常见。
scenarios.example: I would have helped if I had known. 若早知我会帮。

scenarios.title: 过去结果的推测
scenarios.explain: 在特定语境中表本会发生但未发生。
scenarios.example: Without the error, we would have shipped on time. 若无错误本会准时发。

tense_15.collocations: thought/expected/said + would have done；by then / by Friday；if + had done。
tense_15.confusion: 在转述中不说明结果是否兑现；在 if + had done 中，would have done 通常表示事实没有发生。

tense_16.timelineDesc: 站在过去，预计到后来某点，动作已经持续一段时间；真实使用频率很低。

sentences.affirmative: I knew I would have been working there for a year.
sentences.negative: I would not have been waiting long.
sentences.question: How long would she have been working?
sentences.passive: 不用刻意构造，优先改写。

scenarios.title: 过去预计后来的累计时长
scenarios.explain: 从过去看，到后来会持续多久。
scenarios.example: I knew that by June I would have been working there for a year. 我知道到6月会工作满一年。

scenarios.title: 转述完成进行时
scenarios.explain: will have been doing 后移。
scenarios.example: She said she would have been studying for six months by then. 她说届时学满半年。

scenarios.title: 假设中的持续结果
scenarios.explain: 描述若条件成立本会持续的过程。
scenarios.example: Without the move, I would have been working there for ten years. 若没搬走就工作10年了。

scenarios.title: 解释假设状态
scenarios.explain: 说明本来会因持续活动形成的状态。
scenarios.example: I would have been feeling exhausted. 我本会一直感到筋疲力尽。

tense_16.collocations: would have been doing + for/since；by then / by + 后来时间；常依赖明确的过去视角。
tense_16.confusion: 它只是「过去视角 + 后来截止点 + 持续时长」的组合。理解逻辑即可，不必主动追求复杂表达。

tense_05.timelineDesc: 动作被放进一个已经结束的过去时间盒子，与现在不再连接。

sentences.negative: I did not call the buyer.
sentences.question: Did the customer reply?

scenarios.title: 过去已完成事件
scenarios.explain: 有明确过去时间，和现在断开。
scenarios.example: I sent the quotation yesterday. 我昨天发了报价。

scenarios.title: 过去事件序列
scenarios.explain: 按发生顺序推进叙事。
scenarios.example: She opened the file and called me. 她打开文件后打给我。

scenarios.title: 过去习惯或状态
scenarios.explain: 过去反复/长期如此，现在未必。
scenarios.example: I worked there for five years. 我曾在那里工作5年。

scenarios.title: 礼貌弱化
scenarios.explain: I wanted / wondered 让请求更委婉。
scenarios.example: I wondered if you could help. 不知您能否帮忙。

tense_05.collocations: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2024, when I was..., then；明确结束的过去时间。
tense_05.confusion: I worked there for five years 通常表示已离开；I have worked there for five years 通常表示仍在。

tense_09.timelineDesc: 从现在对未来作临时决定、承诺、主观判断或中性陈述。

sentences.negative: I will not change the price.
sentences.question: Will the buyer accept it?
sentences.passive: The order will be approved tomorrow.

scenarios.title: 临时决定
scenarios.explain: 说话当下才决定。
scenarios.example: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it. 电话响了，我来接。

scenarios.title: 主观预测
scenarios.explain: 判断来自观点，不强调眼前证据。
scenarios.example: I think sales will improve. 我认为销量会改善。

scenarios.title: 承诺、提议、请求
scenarios.explain: 用will表意愿。
scenarios.example: I'll send it tonight. 我今晚一定发。

scenarios.title: 中性未来事实
scenarios.explain: 陈述未来会发生的事。
scenarios.example: The event will take place in May. 活动将在5月举行。

tense_09.collocations: I think, probably, perhaps, maybe, I promise；tomorrow / next week只说明未来，不自动决定结构。
tense_09.confusion: will 不是所有未来的默认答案：已有打算、落实安排和固定时刻表各有更自然的表达。
